README:
G1 step 2 device selection (docs/G1_step2_preregistration.md §2-§4). Reads the Perovskite Database CSV, builds the
same-paper absorber-thickness SERIES (main test) and the FAMILY device lists (secondary test), maps each stack onto
the step-2 library (production + g1s2_overlay.yaml) and writes phase0/g1s2/designs.json.
Measured values are copied into the file for the analysis step; this script prints only counts, never PCE values.

Mapping decisions (fixed here, before any simulation):
  * Series: TL thicknesses = median over the series' rows that give a full per-layer list, else the §2 defaults.
    Only the absorber thickness varies inside a series (that is what the series tests).
  * Family devices: each device's own per-layer thicknesses (families require complete thicknesses, §4).
  * A family is eligible if >= 20 of its devices are simulable (stack + single-metal back contact).
